a.xlink:title: Base class for Eye, draw nothing.
Base face composed of two eyes and a mouth. Also the Stack-chan default face [・_・].
A single round eye made of concentric rings (bullseye), for a face with one eye.
[O O] face with tall ellipse eyes and no mouth
Face with a single bullseye eye at the center and no mouth.
[OωO] face with ellipse eyes and an omega-shaped mouth
[▯ ▯] face with round-rectangle eyes and no mouth
Toon face with eyelid-and-eyelash eyes (ToonEye1) and ToonMouth1.
Toon face with quadrilateral-eyelid eyes (ToonEye2) and an omega mouth.
